verdict.rationale: Penpot exposes a plugin API, webhook system, access tokens, and now an official MCP server that lets agents read/interact with design files (penpot-docs-1/3/5/6, penpot-probe-rt-2), giving substantial programmatic access beyond typical design tools. However there is no documented OpenAPI/REST spec (probe-2 shows 404s) and no explicit claim or evidence of full UI/API parity — e.g. component management, prototyping interactions, and design-token editing are documented as UI features without confirmed API equivalents. Missing for 10: explicit API-completeness documentation, published OpenAPI/REST spec covering all UI actions, and independent confirmation that complex workflows (prototyping, tokens, component restore) are fully scriptable via API/MCP.
